subject: Nanotechnology
title: Triboelectric Nanogenerators
description: A quick, practical guide to Triboelectric Nanogenerators.

hook.text: Rub two surfaces together and static charge builds — triboelectric nanogenerators harvest that friction as power.

buildup.text: Nano-textured surfaces maximize contact area and charge transfer — amplifying the triboelectric effect enormously.

discovery.text: TENGs produce high voltage at low current — perfect for directly driving sensors and small electronics.

twist.text: Humidity kills triboelectric charge — water molecules screen the surface and drain the signal.

climax.text: Waterproof TENG designs now harvest wave energy from oceans — blue energy from every passing wave.

punchline.text: Friction at nano surfaces turns any motion into usable electricity.

quiz.question: What limits triboelectric nanogenerator performance?
options: They only work in a vacuum
Humidity screens surface charge, reducing output — requiring waterproof or sealed designs
They require extremely high temperatures to operate
